author: Tom Chaney
text:
Ridiculously, hilariously inaccurate.  

First one was consistently high by 40-45 points.  Second one was consistently high by 25-35 points.  Third one was consistently high by 30-35 points.  The most recent one was high by 80+ points.

 It’s a massive point of stress to see that, and then blood testing reveals it’s nowhere near accurate.  Numbers were confirmed via two separate testing platforms.  I had blood work done by the lab that also confirmed my findings. 

 I pulled it off and trashed it, and I’m not using another one again.  You have problem, and I’m not financing your product testing any further.
